I am a PhD candidate in [Applied Economics at the University of Minnesota](https://apec.umn.edu/). My research focuses on environmental and natural resource economics, land use economics, ecosystem services, and geospatial analysis. My dissertation combines econometric and biophysical modeling to estimate land-use responses and ecosystem-service values at global scale and fine spatial resolution. Recent work includes a global, pixel-level land supply elasticity database at 300 m resolution and a framework for valuing avoided landslide mortality from forest cover.

I also work on integrated modeling that couples economic models with spatially explicit ecosystem-service models, including a framework for measuring the ecosystem services impacts of land-related policies in Africa, developed with collaborators at the [European Commission Joint Research Centre](https://joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu/index_en) and [Wageningen University and Research](https://www.wur.nl/en). I am working on the development of a fine-scale land use / land cover projection framework for Korea, and I am collaborating with [The Nature Conservancy](https://www.nature.org/) on a related linkage focused on conservation finance and commitments in the Amazon. I have presented this work at the Global Trade Analysis Project (GTAP) annual conferences in [Kigali (2025)](https://www.gtap.agecon.purdue.edu/events/conferences/2025/index.aspx) and [Kyoto (2026)](https://www.gtap.agecon.purdue.edu/events/conferences/2026/index.aspx).

I am a student member of [NatCap TEEMs](https://natcapteems.umn.edu/) (Natural Capital Alliance: The Earth-Economy Modelers) and have worked as a research assistant with the [Minnesota Climate Adaptation Partnership](https://climate.umn.edu/) on geospatial analysis of climate projections and cooling center accessibility. I currently teach Principles of Macroeconomics as an adjunct instructor at [Augsburg University](https://www.augsburg.edu/) ([course site](https://m-braaksma.github.io/eco112_fall2026/)). Previously, I was a Student Research Associate at the [Center for Health Economics and Policy Studies](https://cheps.sdsu.edu/) (CHEPS) at San Diego State University. I completed my MA in Economics at San Diego State University and my BA in Business Administration at Eastern Washington University.
